name: io.github.omnislash157/graphyos
title: graphy
description: Compile any codebase into a walkable graph and serve it over MCP: hunt, descend, blast, walk, draw, explain. Every answer is a walk over the code's structure; no model decides an edge.

packageArguments.description: the verb: the MCP server on stdio

packageArguments.name: --repo
packageArguments.description: the repo `graphy eat .` compiled — the server reads <repo>/.graphy/tenant.json and refuses when the repo has not been eaten
